currentTriggerSummary: review-pr: feat(perps): add order book to order entry page
notes: The PR implements the full TAT-3309 scope, and this review verified it rather than assuming it. All 6 ticket acceptance criteria plus the 5 verbatim Gherkin claims in the PR body were reproduced live against the running extension: 102/102 recipe nodes passed with behavioural (not presence-only) assertions — USD totals across all 10 ladder rows, aria-valuenow step/clamp transitions, a real mouse drag proven to move AND stay within bounds, the limit prefill compared against the tapped row's own price, and post-market-switch rows asserted disjoint from the captured previous-market rows. Static analysis is clean (lint:tsc 0 errors; 333/333 tests across the 9 affected suites). Coverage is 11/11 PROVEN with no weak, missing or untestable rows; notably the compact/popup half of AC5 was proven live via CDP viewport emulation rather than being deferred to unit tests as in the parent run. Scope is complete, not partial: no acceptance criterion is unimplemented. Three defects were found in the new panel's layout/a11y chrome (dead ResizeObserver on the cold-load path, value column clipped at 360px popup width, divider not focusable on click) — these are quality findings against a fully-implemented scope, not missing scope, and none affects order submission or pricing. The feature is dark-launched behind perpsOrderBookEnabled (production default OFF).
